description: Defines the BaseViewModel class for handling UI interactions in the Notesnook project, including list management, sorting, and group finding functionalities.

classes.name: BaseViewModel
classes.description: A class providing methods to interact with list views, handle sorting, and find groups within the Notesnook web application.

methods.name: findGroup
methods.description: Finds a group header element by name within the list.

methods.name: iterateItems
methods.description: Asynchronously iterates over list items, yielding each item locator.

methods.name: waitForItem
methods.description: Waits for a list item with a specific title to appear.

methods.name: waitForList
methods.description: Waits for the list placeholder or list to be visible.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focuses on the first list item.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates a key press on the list.

methods.name: sort
methods.description: Performs sorting actions based on provided options.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the list is empty.
